scale.source: CLDR RBNF ru renders 10^9 as "один миллиард" and 10^12 as "один триллион": Russian names 10^9 "миллиард" and counts the -illions in the short scale. Wiktionary (en), "триллион": "trillion".

group_mark.source: CLDR common/main/ru.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae), number symbols: the group symbol is U+00A0, a no-break space. No dot groups digits.

decimal_mark.source: CLDR common/main/ru.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae), number symbols: the decimal symbol is a comma.

space_groups.source: CLDR common/main/ru.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae), number symbols: the group symbol is a no-break space, so groups of three digits after a space are one number.

plural_scale_needs_count.source: CLDR RBNF ru writes a plural scale word only after its count ("две тысячи", 2000). A plural scale word with no count names an amount, not a number.

scale_noun_agrees.source: CLDR RBNF ru %spellout-cardinal-masculine renders 10^6, 2 x 10^6, 5 x 10^6 and 21 x 10^6 as "один миллион", "два миллиона", "пять миллионов", "двадцать один миллион": the scale noun takes the number and case its count governs. The count governs by its last word, so the singular also follows 21. The scale words of this lexicon are scale_numeral entries whose plural flag carries that agreement.

joiner_tens_units.source: CLDR RBNF ru %spellout-cardinal-masculine: "20: двадцать[ >>];", no conjunction between tens and units.

joiner_after_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF ru: "100: сто[ >>];", no conjunction after the hundreds.

joiner_between_groups.source: CLDR RBNF ru renders 1001 as "одна тысяча один", no conjunction between groups.

joiner_before_round_hundred.source: CLDR RBNF ru renders 1100 as "одна тысяча сто" and 1500 as "одна тысяча пятьсот": no joiner stands before a round hundred after the thousands.

hundred_counts_below_thousand.source: unicode-rbnf 2.4.1 (CLDR RBNF ru data), %spellout-cardinal, rendering of 2100: "две тысячи сто": the hundred after the thousands is the next group, so a hundred multiplier takes no count of a thousand or more.

compound_parts_by_role.source: compound_words is true, with the source quoted there: the compound number words it cites join cardinal and ordinal words and joiners only, so a fraction noun or a collective is no part of one ("petin|dvajset" is no split).

comma_between_classes.source: CLDR RBNF ru writes no comma between two classes (1001, 1100 and 1500 in the joiner settings above). No source opened shows a comma between two classes of one number, so a comma ends a number.

joiner_before_last_group.source: CLDR RBNF ru renders 1001 as "одна тысяча один": no conjunction stands before the last group.

ordinal_style.source: CLDR RBNF ru renders 2023 in %spellout-ordinal-masculine as "две тысячи двадцать третий": only the last word is ordinal.

compound_words.source: Д. Э. Розенталь, "Справочник по правописанию и литературной правке", 4th edition (1985), § 45, item 5: an ordinal that ends in a thousand or a million is one word ("двадцатипятитысячный"); CLDR RBNF ru writes 2000th as "двухтысячный". Wiktionary (en), "полмиллиона": "half a million". A word that is a sequence of number words reads as its parts.

bare_noun_counts_one.source: Russian has no article, so a singular collective or fraction noun alone counts one. Wiktionary (en), "четверть": "quarter, fourth", with the usage "три четверти" (three quarters); Wiktionary (en), "дюжина": "dozen".

decimal_fractions.source: CLDR RBNF ru renders 2.5 as "две целых пять десятых" and 2.25 as "две целых двадцать пять сотых": the decimals are a fraction whose denominator is a power of ten.

joiner_after_decimal_marker.source: Д. Э. Розенталь, "Справочник по правописанию и литературной правке", 4th edition (1985), § 45, item 3: "три целых и шесть седьмых". The conjunction "и" may follow "целых" before the fraction; CLDR RBNF ru writes none ("две целых пять десятых").

joiner.source: Д. Э. Розенталь, "Справочник по правописанию и литературной правке", 4th edition (1985), § 45: "с половиной" adds a half ("четырех с половиной тысячный"), and "и" joins the whole part to a fraction ("три целых и шесть седьмых"). "и" joins nothing else: the tens, hundreds and groups take no joiner.

decimal_marker.source: CLDR RBNF ru: "x.x: [<< $(cardinal,one{целая}other{целых})$ ]>%%fractions-feminine>;" and the genitive "целой". Wiktionary (en), "запятая": "decimal point".

minus_idioms.source: This lexicon lists no Russian idiom that puts "минус" before a positive number.

negative_particle.source: Wiktionary, "ни", Russian particle: "not a", "ни один из ста" (not one in a hundred). After "ни" the word for one is a negative pronoun, "not a single", and counts nothing.

number_name.source: Wiktionary (ru), "один и тот же": "Устойчивое сочетание", "тот же самый", "В школе мы с Антоном учились в одном и том же классе."; Wiktionary (ru), "одно и то же": "Устойчивое сочетание (местоимение)", "о чём-либо повторяющемся, похожем, сходном с чем-либо", "Всегда одно и то же." The set phrase means "the same" in every gender, number and case, and counts nothing.

article_one.source: Russian has no article; "один" is a numeral.

of.source: Russian marks the counted noun by case, with no "of" word.

fraction_of.source: Russian marks the counted noun by case, with no "of" word.

denominator_particle.source: Russian has no particle like Portuguese "avos".

class_noun.source: Russian names no digit class with a singular noun after a collective.

half_unit.source: Д. Э. Розенталь (1985), § 46: a half before a unit is one word with it ("полметра", "полкилограмма").

abbreviation.source: No Russian number word in this lexicon is also an abbreviation with a period.

lone_decimal_mark.source: CLDR common/main/ru.xml (unicode-org/cldr c0b65ae): the decimal symbol is a comma; a comma before the first digit marks decimals.

ordinal_suffix_mark.source: CLDR RBNF ru %digits-ordinal-masculine: "0: =#,##0=-й;": the ordinal ending follows the digits after a hyphen.

range_cue.source: Wiktionary (en), "между": "between, among". The joiner between the two limits is "и", which ends the first number.
